title: Two novel tetranuclear lanthanide complexes (Ln = Tb(III) and Dy(III)) with luminescence and slow magnetic relaxation behaviors

synthesis.procedure: Tb(tmhd)3·2H2O (0.03 mmol) was dissolved in 25 mL of n-heptane and heated to reflux for 3 h. The solution was cooled to 70 °C and a CH2Cl2 solution (5 mL) of HL (0.05 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred at 70 °C for 1 h, then cooled to room temperature, filtered, and the filtrate was concentrated in the dark by slow diffusion at 4 °C. Block-shaped red crystals suitable for single-crystal X-ray diffraction formed after 5 days.
synthesis.temperature: reflux (3 h), then 70 °C (1 h), crystallization at 4 °C
synthesis.time: 3 h reflux + 1 h stirring; crystals after 5 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reflux then slow diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; filtrate placed in the dark and concentrated by slow diffusion at 4 °C; block-shaped red crystals after 5 days

properties.summary: Solid-state luminescence at room temperature shows four characteristic Tb(III) emission peaks, with the strongest at 545 nm (5D4 → 7F5). DC magnetic susceptibility under 1000 Oe gives χMT = 47.73 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, decreasing to 39.03 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with weak antiferromagnetic exchange and/or depopulation of Tb3+ Stark sublevels (Curie–Weiss θ = −3.54 K).

measurements.name: emission maximum (5D4 → 7F5)
measurements.conditions: solid-state luminescent spectrum of 1 at room temperature

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1, replacing Tb(tmhd)3·2H2O with Dy(tmhd)3·2H2O. Dy(tmhd)3·2H2O (0.03 mmol) was dissolved in 25 mL of n-heptane, refluxed 3 h, cooled to 70 °C, treated with a CH2Cl2 solution (5 mL) of HL (0.05 mmol), stirred 1 h at 70 °C, cooled, filtered, and crystallized by slow diffusion at 4 °C. Red block-shaped crystals formed after about 5 days.
synthesis.temperature: reflux (3 h), then 70 °C (1 h), crystallization at 4 °C
synthesis.time: 3 h reflux + 1 h stirring; crystals after about 5 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reflux then slow diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; red block-shaped crystals after about 5 days

properties.summary: DC χMT at 300 K is 56.97 cm3 K mol−1, rising slightly on cooling to 50 K then falling to 33.13 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with weak ferromagnetic Dy···Dy coupling (θ = 1.92 K). Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility is temperature- and frequency-dependent, with χ″ peaks at 7–12 K and an Arrhenius barrier ΔE/kB = 81.76 K (τ0 = 6.05 × 10−8 s), indicating SMM-like slow magnetic relaxation with a quantum-tunneling upturn at low T.

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE/kB
measurements.conditions: zero-dc-field ac susceptibility; Arrhenius fit of ln τ vs 1/T

measurements.name: pre-exponential factor τ0
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius law τ = τ0 exp(ΔE/kB T)
